summary: Plaud Transcripts Corrected With Your Own Terminology Glossary: Fixes the words your transcription keeps getting wrong, by giving the pipeline your vocabulary instead of hoping a bigger model guesses right. Every speech model mangles terms it has never seen: cell line and reagent names, drug and device names, case and matter numbers, part numbers, local spelling and number conventions, team and client names. Swapping to a different model does not fix this, because none of them have your terms e.
